title: Menus
description: The view band's own buttons as a part: Save what is up, into the view up or as a new one named in the band, and in its menu Save as new view and Delete, each a person's change to a kept view (core's lens).

actions.title: Save a view
actions.description: Keep what is up as a view: into the kept view named (id), else as a new one under its title. A view a pack ships saved under its own name (preset) is the owner's version of it.

id.description: The kept view to save into, by id; left out, a new one is made.

filter.description: The query's filter: find, only, not.

walk.description: The query's walk: over and steps.

limit.description: How many it draws at most.

time.description: The time the query is asked at, when it is.

style.description: How it is drawn: shape, style (a layout's id) and lit.

preset.description: The view a pack ships that this is the owner's version of.

actions.title: Delete a view
actions.description: Retire a kept view: it leaves the bar and Home, and can be used again from its page.
